about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for hse-cis80 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The intro text ends with words from page 2: a fragment of the table header plus the guidance notice and copyright line.
findings.evidence: tree: "to record your plan. present do you have? This guidance is issued by the Health and Safety Executive."

findings.problem: The page number is joined to the last sentence.
The hazards template table is read as running text, and each hazard heading is joined to the last bullet of the previous hazard, so controls sit under the wrong heading.
findings.evidence: tree: "using guardrails, midrails and toeboards Collapse of excavations"

findings.problem: The column headings 'Hazard is present' and 'What controls do you have?' are split; half is in this text and half moved into page 1 text.
findings.evidence: source: "Hazard is present" "What controls do you have?" / tree: "Hazard is What controls"

findings.problem: The Plan and Working together form is read as one run-on note, not as a form or table of fields.
findings.evidence: tree: "Your name/company Name and address of client Contact details of architect"
